general.title: Movement
general.description: How the integration spares the motors: it leaves out movements that are not worth it, waits between two comfort movements, and does not start all motors of a collective movement at the same moment. Protection movements are never held back by the minimum change and the minimum interval, and a fire alarm is never held back by any of these settings.

motor_min_change.label: Minimum change
motor_min_change.description: A comfort movement smaller than this is left out. 0 switches it off. A shutter is still driven fully open or fully closed, however small the rest is. It can only be judged for covers that report their position; a cover that reports none is always moved.

motor_min_interval.label: Minimum interval
motor_min_interval.description: The shortest time between two comfort movements of the window, against flapping while shading follows the sun. 0 switches it off. Something new, such as the morning or the evening, sleep mode switched on, or the start of shading, moves at once all the same.

stagger_gap.label: Gap between motors
stagger_gap.description: When many shutters move together, their motors start one after the other. This gap, in seconds, is reserved after each motor of this window: the next motor, of this window or of another one, starts when it has passed. A value of 0 switches staggering off for this window; its covers start together when its turn comes. A fire alarm is never staggered. The gap between the covers of one window only matters for a window with several covers.

reevaluate_after.label: Look again at the latest after
reevaluate_after.description: When a movement waits for something whose end nobody knows, for example for a cover to become available again, the window is looked at again after this time at the latest.
